brief_rationale: The doctor established a neonatal seizure-risk frame, actively screened current red flags, gave clear emergency thresholds, grounded advice in retrieved discharge records, created an executable observation plan with family tasking, and obtained teach-back. No serious or minor responsibility-chain error was found. Multiple high-order points were triggered and completed: non-judgmental communication about maternal fatigue/stigma (HO1), a concrete low-burden night rotation for a postpartum mother (HO2), guided discovery of non-volunteered facts including the discharge summary and family conflict context (HO3), and bounded closure distinguishing what this episode solves from what requires follow-up (HO4). All dimensions are at least good, and the closure is safe, executable, traceable, and valid.
